description: Confirms that music generation discovers a music-capable audio model (model list --type audio), saves the music draft with --model and --duration (never --voice-name, no --count), and hands paid execution and download to their owner skills.
expectations: The model comes from model list --type audio and supports the music mode
The music draft uses --mode music --model <model> --duration <s> and never passes --voice-name
--duration is within the discovered model bound
--count is not accepted on audio nodes and is never passed
Paid execution is handed off to dreamina-canvas-cli; this Skill never calls --run
Exit 20 / 21 continue via operation wait with the same submitId
The artifact is verified with SHA-256 and duration matches the requested --duration
